name: sarwa
description: Tharwa workspace — run dev from here to start API + admin together

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend-api --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix admin-dashboard --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,admin -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend-api" "npm run dev --prefix admin-dashboard"
